questions.question:
In the following question below are given some statements followed by some conclusions based on those statements. Taking the given statements to be true even if they seem to be at variance from commonly known facts. Read all the conclusions and then decide which of the given conclusion logically follows the given statements.

**Statements:**

I. Some S are P.

II. No P is L.

**Conclusion:**

I. All S are P.

II. All L are S.

options.text: Both conclusions I and II follows

questions.solution:
As per the given statements, the least possible Venn diagram is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/dedec0199563a28a0b6f968b9eb0eee1b40ecd6c37a6864deb797829c6e61803.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a1a6f646fe550bd0e17289c583277c48455118eab02cf5883ee57a18dbe67d6b.png] 

Conclusion:

I. All S are P. → **Not follow** (Because Some S are P, all P are S can be a possibility only)

II. All L are S. → **Not follow** (Because there is no definite relation between L and S, so it can be possible only)

Hence, the correct answer is** "Neither conclusion follows".**

**Statements:**

I. Some B are T.

**Conclusion:**

II. Some T are B.

III. Some T are K.

options.text: Both conclusions I and II follows

Hence, the correct answer is** "Both conclusions I and II follow".**

questions.question:
If A denotes 'addition', B denotes 'multiplication', C denotes 'subtraction', and D denotes 'division', then what will be the value of the following equation?

7 A (18 D 3) C 5 = ?
questions.solution:
Here, we use the table given below:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f17fe402f98bb01e6c434026861e42229a2db5fdddb9ac339c012f7a2b73afa8.png] 

As per the given data:

 
 

 **Symbol**
 **Means**
 
 

 A
 Addition (+)
 
 

 B
 Multiplication (×)
 
 

 C
 Subtraction (-)
 
 

 D
 Division (÷) 
 
 

Given:

7 A (18 D 3) C 5 =?

⇒ 7 + (__**18 ÷ 3**__) - 5

Apply BODMAS rule:

⇒ 7 + 6 - 5

⇒ 13 - 5 = **8**

Hence, the correct answer is **"8".**

questions.question:
Words given on the left side of (::) are related with each other by some Logic/Rule/Relation. Select the missing word/word pair on the right side of (:) from the given alternatives based on the same Logic/Rule/Relation.

Cow : Herbivorous :: ?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Cow : Herbivorous → The cow is a herbivorous animal.

Checking all the given options as per the logic:

**(1) Elephant : Herbivorous → The elephant is a herbivorous animal.**

(2) Goat : Carnivorous → The goat is a herbivorous animal.

(3) Sheep : Carnivorous → The sheep is a herbivorous animal.

(4) Carnivorous : Lion → The lion is a carnivorous animal.

Here, 'Elephant : Herbivorous' is the correct pair.

Hence, the correct answer is "**Elephant: Herbivorous**".
